title: Application by Western Massachusetts Electric Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 476, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a reduction in the quarterly charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billing month of February, 1985. The Fuel Charge reflects changes in prudently incurred reasonable costs of fuels and power purchased by the Company.
